text:
Rina Das: Quick heads-up — Stratos Integrations Developer Day next Wed. Joint session: marketplace walkthrough + live mini-lab (Redwood Private + Stratos appliance). Need final speaker confirmations, demo rollback plan, attendee QR for swag raffle, and small recording plan.

Owen Li: I'll own routing and failover. Primary: Stratos rack (on-prem at venue), fallback: Redwood Dedicated (eu-west). Canary 65/35. Failover trigger: p95 > 450ms for 60s OR 5xx rate > 0.7%.

Priya Kapoor: I'll coordinate speakers + marketing. Speaker flow draft: 09:50 intro (Rina), 10:00 Stratos marketplace demo (Stratos PM), 10:12 Redwood infra + live demo (Owen), 10:25 Q&A + raffle. Need headshots + bios by Mon EOD.

Marco Leone: Kits & swag: RDW-STRATOS-LABKIT x9 crates. Courier: SkyHaul AWB SH443322. ETA Tue 17:30. Swag: 120 stickers, 40 hoodies, 30 power banks. Manifest and commercial invoice uploaded: https://drive.example/rdw/stratos/manifest.pdf.

ops-bot: Reminder: rehearsal Tue 16:00 PT. Calendar invites sent. Venue requires signed liability waiver for demo hardware.

Owen Li: Quick preflight commands for Stratos appliance health:

```
curl -s http://10.11.12.15:8080/health | jq -r .status  # expect "ok"
ssh deploy@10.11.12.15 "journalctl -u redwood-edge -n 200"
```

Rina Das: Marketing timing: Stratos wants the marketplace listing live at 12:30 local that day and a joint social post T+15m. Need three copy variants + one screenshot by Mon 18:00; legal signoff by Mon 12:00.

Marco Leone: SkyHaul notes: customs needs ECCN + vendor EIN on crate. I uploaded both. Local contact: Hana +44-7700-4455. Tracking: https://skyhaul.example/track/SH443322.

Priya Kapoor: AV checklist: HDMI adapters (USB-C, miniDP), 2x spare ethernet, small UPS, USB capture device for recording. We'll produce a 5-min highlight clip post-event. Also want a 90s fallback video on S3.

Owen Li: Failover automation snippet (pseudo):

```
# monitor and flip
if monitor.p95 > 450 and sustained(60s):
  call_console_route_switch(route="dedicated-eu-west")
  post_slack("Failover engaged -> dedicated-eu-west")
```

Marco Leone: SkyHaul delivered AWB updated: status shows delivered to loading dock Wed 17:28 local. I'll confirm onsite pickup tomorrow AM.

ops-bot: Note: bring two printed emergency contact sheets and a copy of the liability waiver to the booth.

Rina Das: Action items recap: @Owen run failover test + pin model version by Tue EOD; @Marco confirm SkyHaul delivery + local pickup by Tue noon; @Priya finalize bios + marketing copy + upload fallback clip by Mon 18:00; legal OK by Mon 12:00. React with :white_check_mark: when done.

Owen Li: :white_check_mark: will run tests Tue night and pin `rw-stratos-q4k-v2`.

Marco Leone: :white_check_mark: confirmed pickup & manifest in Drive.

Priya Kapoor: :white_check_mark: bios + copy + fallback clip uploaded.

ops-bot: Rehearsal reminder: Tue 16:00 PT — invite includes run-of-show and stream layout.
